# FinanceSpots

> Free financial calculators and tools for mortgages, VA loans, taxes, investments, crypto, budgeting, and retirement planning. 110+ expert-built tools with instant PDF export. No signup required.

## About

FinanceSpots is a free platform built by Abdul Rahman to give everyone access to professional-grade financial tools and education. All calculators are free to use instantly — no account needed.

- Site: https://financespots.com
- Owner: Abdul Rahman
- Contact: chabdulrehman4546@gmail.com

## Tool Categories

- [Loan Calculators](https://financespots.com/tools/loan-calculators/): Mortgage, VA loan, auto loan, personal loan, student loan calculators
- [Investment Tools](https://financespots.com/tools/investment-tools/): ROI, compound interest, dividend, portfolio analyzer
- [Tax Calculators](https://financespots.com/tools/tax-calculators/): Income tax estimator, capital gains, self-employment tax
- [Savings Planners](https://financespots.com/tools/savings-planners/): Emergency fund, savings goal, CD calculator
- [Retirement Planning](https://financespots.com/tools/retirement-planning/): 401k, IRA, FIRE, Social Security calculators
- [Budget Analyzers](https://financespots.com/tools/budget-analyzers/): 50/30/20 planner, monthly budget, expense tracker
- [Crypto Tools](https://financespots.com/tools/crypto-tools/): Bitcoin profit, DCA simulator, staking rewards, crypto tax
- [Currency Converters](https://financespots.com/tools/currency-converters/): Live forex rates, 150+ currencies
